subject.title: Interrupted sessions marked unrecoverable after gateway restart (transcript tail is not resumable)

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101674 is fixed, should this issue remain a separate transcript atomicity fix target or be folded into the broader non-resumable-tail recovery design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95609?
rationale: The current source-level failure branch is real, but the suspected cause depends on a linked provider retry bug and a missing transcript-tail sample, so an automated fix would risk choosing the wrong owner boundary.

options.title: Retest After Sonnet Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open as a focused follow-up and require a transcript-tail or restart-recovery repro after the Sonnet 5 retry fix lands.

options.title: Fold Into Non-Resumable UX Tracker
options.body: Treat the observed failure as another instance of the broader recover-and-confirm design gap tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95609.

options.title: Start Atomic Transcript Repair Now
options.body: Queue a fix only if maintainers accept the report's retry-writer cause without waiting for the linked provider retry issue to settle.

recommendation.title: Retest After Sonnet Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as a focused follow-up and require a transcript-tail or restart-recovery repro after the Sonnet 5 retry fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the original restart-aborted main-session recovery behavior and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding the recovery boundary.
